messages:
Owen (Support): FYI - VeloxAI hit a hard blocker during onboarding. embeddings are ~30% lower quality vs P0 test prompts and they're seeing rate-limit 429s during batch ingest. Customer is pushing to GA next month and renewal conversation in 6 weeks. Escalating to CS for comms + prioritization.
Maya (CS): Thanks, Owen. Can you drop the support ticket id and a quick TL;DR of what changed in their flow?
Owen (Support): Ticket #S-2026-4982. They switched from our hosted embeddings to a large-batch ingest via our dedicated endpoint, using concurrency=12 and chunk_size=2048. Harsh validated the reproducer.
Harsh (Support Eng): Confirmed repro. When concurrency >=8 we see queuing + some request timeouts -> retries cause duplicate ingestion and quality variance due to partial batching. Stack traces show timeouts in the gateway: `gateway/http_handler.go:212`.
Maya (CS): Got it. This is both an onboarding blocker and a renewal risk. Lina — can you advise comms plan and whether we should escalate to an AE/exec? vic (AE) is on thread.
Lina (CS Manager): @Maya, yes. Immediate plan: 1) Acknowledge to customer within 1hr with status and temporary mitigation (quota bump + reduce concurrency), 2) schedule a joint troubleshooting + enablement call within 48h, 3) proposal for follow-up health check before renewal. Also recommend AE exec touch if GA timeline at risk.
vic (AE): I'll join call and prep the renewal context. Recommend exec outreach only if we see any multi-day outage or missed GA.
Maya (CS): Owen/Harsh — can you provide a short mitigation snippet we can share? Need safe instructions for the customer to avoid data corruption.
Harsh (Support Eng): Mitigation snippet:```
- Reduce concurrency to 4
- Set chunk_size to 1024
- Use exponential backoff for 429s, base=200ms, max=5s
- If ingest latency > 3s, pause and contact support
```This avoids duplicate retries and keeps KV cache warm.
Owen (Support): I've posted the snippet in the ticket and attached the logs. Also suggested a temporary quota bump to 1.5x for the next 72h; pending shard approval.
Maya (CS): I'll send the customer a short note in 30m: acknowledgement + mitigation steps + propose 48h call. Lina — can you draft the customer success enablement agenda? Want to include architecture review, ingest best practices, and a dry-run.
Lina (CS Manager): Draft agenda: 1) Quick introductions 5m, 2) Current state & impact 10m, 3) Root-cause walkthrough (Harsh) 15m, 4) Live config changes & dry-run 20m, 5) Next steps & milestones for GA 10m. I'll share doc and slide deck.
Maya (CS): Also prepping a risk note for renewal: likelihood=medium-high unless GA timeline remains. Will flag with finance + GTM ops.
Owen (Support): Shard team approved quota bump for 72h. I've applied and updated ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: `shard-config/scale 1.5x` by owen at 1779812600
vic (AE): Thanks — please loop in the customer success Slack channel with the meeting invite once scheduled. I'll bring contract fallback options if needed.
Maya (CS): Meeting scheduled: Thu 10am PT (+48h). I'll post calendar and join link. Lina — attaching the draft agenda and a short customer-facing note for review.
Lina (CS Manager): Reviewed and OK. Add a line about rollback plan and data integrity checks.
Maya (CS): Sent customer note: "We're on this — temporary throttling + config guidance applied. We're scheduling a joint troubleshooting session in 48h to validate GA readiness." Customer replied :eyes: and asked for a post-call summary template.
Owen (Support): Adding post-call summary template to the ticket now. Also tagging SRE on standby if we need deeper infra dive.
Lina (CS Manager): Great. Action items: Maya - customer comms + calendar, Lina - agenda + slides, Harsh - RCA + mitigation steps, Owen - ticket owner + logs, vic - AE prep. We'll checkpoint after the call and escalate exec outreach only if GA is delayed >7 days.
Maya (CS): Noted. Thanks team.
Harsh (Support Eng): Will prep a short repro script and runbook snippet to include in the enablement packet.
Owen (Support): Closing loop in ticket for now, will update after the call.
Maya (CS): Marking thread as monitored. :white_check_mark:
